original_test_intent: Benchmark the approved M.2 module with the four specified sequential/random fio profiles and compare IOPS, bandwidth and latency to an M.2-specific specification without touching other data.
original_method: Resolve the copied E1.S scope to an approved M.2 target; map serial/WWN/namespace/PCIe/UUID, prove empty/backup state, pin fio/script, set runtime and per-profile M.2 thresholds; baseline SMART/media/temperature/power; preserve logs; run serialized profiles with hard stops; verify integrity/restore and retain raw results.
manual_activity: Storage owner corrects the M.2 scope and allowlists a disposable module/volume with SPEC/runtime; operator double-verifies identity, backup/empty state, cooling/OOB and recovery.
required_inputs: Empty/backed-up scratch target and restore plan
SMART/thermal/power stop limits and destructive approval
safety_requirements: Do not apply E1.S SPEC to M.2 by assumption
Double-check target before each write profile
Stop on data/media/PCIe/thermal/power anomaly; no auto-retry
engineer_actions: Correct M.2 versus E1.S source scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A fio version check does not execute the benchmark; its M.2 framing helps identify the intended scope but cannot repair the Master conflict.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After source-scope approval, substitute the verified M.2 scratch target for `/dev/sdx` and run the four source profiles with fixed runtime and protected logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 2M seq read/write, 4k random read/write, direct/libaio, depth16, 16 jobs and 1500-minute allowance are retained only for the approved M.2 target.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one immutable M.2 target manifest and serialized jobs with explicit model-specific performance/health acceptance and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects form-factor identity and adds stable targeting, data safety, runtime/spec and monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: E1.S results cannot be counted as M.2 validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Destructive writes can erase data and sustained load can wear/overheat the module.
